0.original: Aeluuin would ask you to make a special delivery.

1.original: Aeluuin has entrusted you with delivering meals to three prospectors at Finders' Bluff: Laughing Fury, Vavapu, and Ademar.

2.original: The three prospectors were overjoyed to receive their long-awaited meals. Inform Aeluuin that they go hungry no more.

3.original: Aeluuin is genuinely pleased to hear that the prospectors at Finders' Bluff enjoyed their meals. It is clear that the innkeep cares deeply for his customers.

48.original: My <hex:020818E905FF0A64656172206C616479FF09676F6F64206D616E03>, I daresay you're more reliable than the rest of my hired help put together. For better or for worse, this means I've got another job for you.

49.original: I've got three basket lunches here that need delivering to Finders' Bluff. After the last adventurer scarfed down three boxes on his own and ran off without paying his tab, I need someone I can trust.

51.original: Diggin' for gold day and night sure works me up an appetite. Is it time for <hex:02083BE3E90C0DFF1C020818E3E90C05FF07737570706572FF0A627265616B6661737403FF18020814E3E90C12FF066C756E6368FF077375707065720303> yet?

52.original: One o' Master Aeluuin's specialty basket lunches? Well, now, don't mind if I do!

53.original: Ah! Will my tummy not stop rumbling? Tummy! I command you! Cease your rumbling!

54.original: From Aeluuin, you say? My tummy and I are much obliged!

55.original: Bloody hog of an adventurer, stealin' the food o' honest, hardworkin' men...

56.original: Are me eyes to be believed!? Thank ye, friend. It's good to know <hex:021A020203>some<hex:021A020103> adventurers can still be trusted.

57.original: Aeluuin's famous basket lunches hit the spot, eh? I thought as much! The prospectors at Finders' Bluff aren't just digging for personal fortune, you know─each onze of gold helps this region thrive and prosper. I'm happy to return the favor.

58.original: You've gone above and beyond for me, and for this you have my thanks. Next time you fancy an ale, a tale, or just a respite from the road, know that there's always a place for you here at the Bobbing Cork.
